Wouldn't this be an error? If yes please do messages::internalError.

Done.
Added `messages::internalError(asyncResp->res)` after the line.
Log an error and do messages::internalError if multiple services are found.

Done.
Added a condition to throw error if more than one service.
If we only need one property please use getProperty method call.

Noted.
Implemantation modified to use `getProperty()` instead.
Is passing this argument strictly necessary?

Noted.
Unnecessary argument removed.
Can't we use association inventory-sensors to get the voltage sensor associated with this processor?

Done.
Implementation modified to use `inventory-sensors` association.
Why is this function being called inside `getProcessorMetricsData`? Shouldn't it be called from `getProcessorData`?

`CoreVoltage` is defined by DMTF Redfish schema only on `ProcessorMetrics`.
In this case, the value has to live at `/redfish/v1/Systems/<str>/Processors/<id>/ProcessorMetrics`.
Therefore, calling the function inside `getProcessorMetricsData` is better than `getProcessorData`.
Please update Redfish.md file with this properties.

Done.
Added `CoreVoltage/Reading` and `CoreVoltage/DataSourceUri` under the `ProcessorMetrics` section in `docs/Redfish.md`.
use sdbusplus::object_path.

Done.
Replaced the `sensorPath + "/chassis"` string concatenation with `sdbusplus::object_path` and the `/=` operator to build the chassis association path, matching the pattern used in `pcie_slots.hpp`.
Please also check for `endpoints` containing multiple items.

Done.
Added a check for `endpoints.size() > 1` after the empty/error check.
